name: Falling Debris
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
description: A net filled with stones and a small anvil crashes down on someone who steps into the room.
disable: DC 17 Thievery check to disarm the trap through a cracked-open door, or Interact to open the door slowly without triggering the trap

offensiveAbilities.name: Drop Debris
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens the door without taking care to avoid triggering the trap;

Effect The net drops a dozen hefty stones and a small but quite hard anvil onto the creature, inflicting 3d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save). The sound of this trap going off alerts Gurtlekep in area C8.
